description: Advance the game: turn toward a target or direction, fire, thrust, and optionally raise your shield or jump to hyperspace, for a number of ticks (20 ticks = 1 second). Returns what happened, a top-down scanner and every rock, saucer, shot and loot as offsets from you.

aim.description: Direction [dx, dy, dz] to turn toward, used when target is left out.

fire.description: Hold fire during this step. Default true.

hyperspace.description: Jump to a random spot (small risk).

shield.description: Raise the shield (uses one charge, lasts 3 seconds).

target.description: id of a rock, saucer or loot to turn toward (r12, s3, l4). Points at where it is now, with no lead.

thrust.description: Thrust along your nose, 0 to 1. Default 0.

name: step
title: Fly a step
